sense.text:
The original Greeks were of the seed of Japheth, Noah’s son, but there came a time when Esau overthrew them and took their place. The old books of the scholars, written in 1879 and 1890 when few of us could read, set down the genealogy of Philip of Macedon back through Esau, Isaac and Abraham, and say plainly that King Philip was a descendant of Esau, the son of Isaac. They wrote those books thinking we would never be able to read and reason.

So when it says “Alexander son of Philip, the Macedonian”, Alexander the Great, Alexander the Greek, was the son of an Edomite, a son of Esau. Those Macedonians were not of Japheth. He “had smitten Darius king of the Persians and Medes” and “reigned in his stead, the first over Greece.”

He “made many wars, and won many strong holds, and slew the kings of the earth”. Satan was rolling with him; he was conquering everybody. He “took spoils of many nations, insomuch that the earth was quiet before him”: nobody could speak up to him. “His heart was lifted up.”

“He fell sick, and perceived that he should die.” It was a bad case of syphilis. They try to hide that, but there are books that say he had a sexually transmitted disease, because he was having sex with everyone and everything.

He “parted his kingdom among them, while he was yet alive.” Ptolemy took Egypt, Lysimachus took Thrace and Asia Minor, Seleucus took Syria and Cassander took Macedonia. Alexander had everything united as one; his generals could not keep it united, and they divided up the kingdom.

The Greeks did it first, and Esau did it again at the Berlin Conference. “With a strange god”: back then, in the time of the Greeks, they worshipped strange gods, Zeus, Aphrodite and the like. The strange god today is Cesare Borgia.

“He shall cause them to rule over many”: his people to rule over many nations and countries. “And shall divide the land for gain”: that is what Alexander’s generals did, and in the late 1800s the rest of the Europeans kept that same energy. Many of these scriptures have levels to them.

At the Berlin Conference no Africans, no Negroes, no Latinos were in the meeting. It was white supremacy. They divided up the entire continent of Africa, and that includes the land of Israel. That is what the Balfour Declaration was about: these so-called Khazars wanted that land.

“The words of his mouth were smoother than butter”: when the white man comes, his words are smoother than butter. He will talk about Jesus, about love, about honour and respect, and you will fall in love with what he says. “But war was in his heart”: his intent all along was war, to destroy you.

They came into Africa with peaceful words. They went in with missionaries who talked the love of a white Jesus: we just love everybody, we love you, dusty Africans. Their mercenaries brought their religions. They learned our strengths and our weaknesses, and then devastated us with colonialism and slavery, and divided Africa for financial gain. That is why Africa is not united today. When Kwame Nkrumah wanted to unite the whole continent with one visa and one financial system backed by gold, the CIA said, we have to get rid of him.

“His words were softer than oil, yet were they drawn swords”: smooth words, but the intent was war. They taught us to read, but not to reason.

Above it, Daniel is speaking of the Greeks, but it says “in the latter time of their kingdom.” The scholars say this is Antiochus Epiphanes, but Antiochus died of a terminal sickness and he never fought against Christ, and as we read down, this man fights Christ. So this is the last kingdom. “The latter time” is what you want to highlight when you are teaching.

“A king of fierce countenance” is a leader, a system, of fierce countenance, “and understanding dark sentences”: this kingdom would understand the scriptures to a degree. “Shall stand up.”

“And his power shall be mighty, but not by his own power”: the dragon, Satan, gave him his power. “And shall destroy the mighty and the holy people”: that is the twelve tribes of Israel. This man destroyed us. We have been destroyed as a people.

“Through his policy also he shall cause craft to prosper in his hand”: through his policies. “He shall magnify himself in his heart”: he set himself up as God, the Son of God, the angels. He said, I’m God, I’m the Son of God, I’m the angels, I am the Jews, I’m Jesus.

“And by peace shall destroy many.” Did not Donald Trump set up a board of peace? You have to pay a billion dollars to get onto it, and its power supersedes the United Nations and the criminal court. They don’t give a damn what the court of justice says. He calls himself the candidate of peace, the president of peace, a peacemaker, and he is the one that attacked Iran. We are living in this time right now: millions, hundreds of thousands, of people dying, women, children, innocent civilians, by peace.

“He shall also stand up against the Prince of princes”: he shall stand up against Christ. “But he shall be broken without hand.” Antiochus Epiphanes never stood up and fought Christ. This is the last kingdom.

precepts.why:
Daniel and John say the same thing. “Therefore rejoice, ye heavens, and ye that dwell in them.” The heavens are not the sky; the sky doesn’t go woo. It is man living in dominion, man living in rulership. Edom today is America, Germany, France, Great Britain, Australia, Canada: those are the heavens. Rejoice, Idumea, “and ye that dwell in them.”

“Woe to the inhabiters of the earth”: destruction to the third world countries, like the continent of Africa. “And of the sea”: the islands, Puerto Rico, Santo Domingo, Haiti, Jamaica, the Melanesian islands. If you are beneath the heavens, woe to you.

“For the devil is come down unto you, having great wrath, because he knoweth that he hath but a short time.” The devil lives in heaven, and his time is almost up. That is why this goes with “the latter time of their kingdom”: the king of fierce countenance understands some things in the scriptures, and he knows his time is short.

Who is in the heaven that rejoices? “For my sword shall be bathed in heaven”: Christ’s sword. “Behold, it shall come down upon Idumea, and upon the people of my curse, to judgment.” Idumea is the Greek and Roman name for Edom.

Don’t let anybody tell you they were already destroyed. Then who is Christ coming back to kill here in Isaiah 34? The heavens of Revelation 12:12 are Idumea, Edom, the nations ruling today.

“Not by his own power”: “the beast which I saw was like unto a leopard”, like the Greeks; “his feet were as the feet of a bear”, like the Persians and Medes; “his mouth as the mouth of a lion”, like Babylon. “And the dragon gave him his power, and his seat, and great authority.”

That dragon is Satan. They say God bless America, but it is Satan who gave them their power. That is why Satan said to Christ, bow down and worship me and I will give you all the glory and the kingdoms of the world, for that is given to me to give to whomsoever I will.

“And it was given unto him to make war with the saints, and to overcome them.” That him is the same man who stands up in the last days, the king of fierce countenance. The saints are the twelve tribes of Israel, “the mighty and the holy people” of Daniel 8:24. They overcame us; they destroyed us. “And power was given him over all kindreds”: he ruled everybody.

Watch the wording. “Therefore shalt thou serve thine enemies which the Lord shall send against thee”: the Lord sent Europe against us, the Lord sent America against us. “In hunger, and in thirst, and in nakedness, and in want of all things”: for food, for water, for clothing. If you want anything, you have to go to your enemies. If you want education, if you want to learn about God, you have to go to your enemies.

“And he shall put a yoke of iron upon thy neck, until he have destroyed thee.” Here is the part we want. The yokes of iron were taken off. What does that prove? That we have been destroyed. That is what Daniel 8:24 says: he “shall destroy the mighty and the holy people.”

sense.text: This is speaking of the nations that America bombs and robs. “Shall they not rise up suddenly that shall bite thee”: the nations they bombed and destroyed shall rise up from sleep, because the remnants of those nations are here in America and in the European countries. “And awake that shall vex thee”: this is talking about terrorism. “And thou shalt be for booties unto them”: they are going to plunder you.

Verse 8 says why terrorism is going to take off. “Because thou hast spoiled many nations”: did they not rob Venezuela? They robbed Panama; they robbed all nations. “All the remnant of the people shall spoil thee”: the remnant of those people are in this country, and they are going to rob you. “Because of men’s blood”: because you killed men.

How do you murder a man’s whole family, his father, mother, wife, son and sister, and then want peace with him? There is no peace, brothers. Only black people are foolish enough to want peace after their whole line has been wiped out.

Some of us love it when the president talks about peace, stomping our feet because we think nothing is going to happen in this country. “But of the times and the seasons, brethren, ye have no need that I write unto you.” Paul is saying, I don’t have to tell you the times and the seasons of Christ’s return; you should know them. We read the prophecies every week. If you are not paying attention, you are going to get caught off guard.

The real brothers and the real sisters will not have to be warned. They are aware of what is about to happen.

“For when they shall say, Peace and safety”: that is what Trump wants, peace and safety. “Then sudden destruction cometh upon them, as travail upon a woman with child; and they shall not escape.”

A pain will come one month, then things calm down; then another pain comes two or three months later, and it calms down again. The Bible says that is how it is going to be in this world. What we notice with the Israelites is that when things calm down we say, nothing’s going to happen, and go back to business as usual.

The peace president has bombed seven countries in his second term: Yemen, Somalia, Iraq, Iran, Syria, Nigeria and Venezuela. And when they incinerate a school of little girls, the children of military officers, do you think you are going to have peace with those fathers, grandfathers, cousins and uncles? There is no money you can give them. They will get you eventually.

precepts.why:
This shows what “as travail upon a woman with child” means. “As when a woman with child in the ninth month bringeth forth her son, with two or three hours of her birth great pains compass her womb, which pains, when the child cometh forth, they slack not a moment”. In the times of nations, those two or three hours translate to two or three months.

Read on: “Even so shall not the plagues be slack to come upon the earth, and the world shall mourn, and sorrows shall come upon it on every side.” When a woman is having a baby, her contractions come ten minutes apart, then six, then five, then four. That is how the plagues and the sorrows come upon the world after they say peace and safety.

sense.text:
Christ tells all of us that tribulation will come, tribulation for the Israelites. “And the stars shall fall from heaven”: this is what the prophets saw, and this is how they described it. Today we know those stars are missiles. He is talking about war. “And the powers of the heavens shall be shaken”: the heavens are Idumea.

They tell us only a handful of people died when missiles fell on Tel Aviv. The devil is lying; their mass media has a cover-up. They don’t want black people buying any news network, because we would give an alternative view of what is really going on.

“And then shall appear the sign of the Son of man in heaven”. When? After the tribulation and the war. World War III is already in process. Don’t think he might come tomorrow: where is the tribulation? The tribulation has not come yet. After that tribulation and war, “they shall see the Son of man coming in the clouds of heaven with power and great glory.”
“And they shall gather together his elect from the four winds, from one end of heaven to the other.” The elect is Israel, and he gathers them from among the nations where they are scattered.

precepts.why: Who is the elect? “For Jacob my servant’s sake, and Israel mine elect”. Israel is the elect, and it is Israel that Christ’s angels gather together from the four winds.

“When I shall have gathered the house of Israel from the people among whom they are scattered”: God gathers Israel from among the peoples where they are scattered, so what are Netanyahu and the not-so-Israelis talking about?

“And shall be sanctified in them in the sight of the heathen, then shall they dwell in their land that I have given to my servant Jacob.” That is the gathering of the elect from the four winds.

sense.text:
“And the serpent cast out of his mouth”: his mouth is the media. Amalek controls all the media; every aspect of it is owned by the so-called Jews, and now they want one family to own all the news networks, and Trump wants to control the entire media.

“Water as a flood after the woman”: the water that comes out of the serpent’s mouth, out of their media, is lies. The woman is our people, the twelve tribes of Israel, and the goal is to draw as many of us as they can into their Christian and democratic lies. That is their agenda.

precepts.why: “And there was given unto him a mouth speaking great things and blasphemies”. “And he opened his mouth in blasphemy against God, to blaspheme his name, and his tabernacle, and them that dwell in heaven.” This man’s mouth is his media. In the time of Rome it was written media, pamphlets sent out everywhere. It started with Rome, and the Americans have it down top-notch today: their message goes out worldwide.

sense.text:
“I beheld then because of the voice of the great words which the horn spake”. The horn here is America; write that down. The voice is their media today, and it goes worldwide. Even in Cuba they had American news on certain channels.

“I beheld even till the beast was slain, and his body destroyed, and given to the burning flame.” Now he calls the horn the beast. This beast is destined to be destroyed.

precepts.why:
Here is the precept for “his body destroyed, and given to the burning flame”: “Therefore shall her plagues come in one day, death, and mourning, and famine; and she shall be utterly burned with fire: for strong is the Lord God who judgeth her.”

“And the kings of the earth, who have committed fornication and lived deliciously with her, shall bewail her”: they cry for this horn, this America, “when they shall see the smoke of her burning”.

The great words of the horn: “And he shall speak great words against the most High”, through their media, which is what we read in Revelation 13.

“And shall wear out the saints of the most High”: they wore us out in slavery, with shackles on our necks, our hands and our ankles, through buck breaking, through working seven days a week from sunup to sundown. “And think to change times and laws”: the daylight saving time we just entered, same-sex marriage laws, and our Sabbath they changed to Sunday. “Until a time and times and the dividing of time”: 250 years.

“A sound of a cry cometh from Babylon”: Babylon here is America. “And great destruction from the land of the Chaldeans”: the Chaldeans are modern Israel today. The Chaldeans were always an ally to Babylon; ancient Babylon were Kushites and the Chaldeans were Semites. Bring it up to today and America is Babylon and the Israelis are the Chaldeans.

“Because the Lord hath spoiled Babylon, and destroyed out of her the great voice”: the great voice is their media, which goes worldwide and captivates and hypnotizes people everywhere. “When her waves do roar like great waters”: the waves are the nations within. “Because the spoiler is come upon her”: that is what we read in Habakkuk, the spoiler shall come upon her and spoil her. “Her mighty men are taken”, as prisoners of war.

“And I will make drunk her princes, and her wise men, her captains”, her admirals and generals, “and her rulers”, the governors and mayors, “and her mighty men”, the soldiers: “and they shall sleep a perpetual sleep, and not wake”. That perpetual sleep is the lake of fire. They are not waking up ever again.

Here is the precept to prove that the waves that roar are the nations. “Woe to the multitude of many people, which make a noise like the noise of the seas; and to the rushing of nations, that make a rushing like the rushing of mighty waters!” “The nations shall rush like the rushing of many waters: but God shall rebuke them, and they shall flee far off, and shall be chased as the chaff of the mountains before the wind”.

sense.text:
This is about more than politics; it is about religion. The man overseeing the war with Iran, the Secretary of War, spoke of the miracle of rebuilding the temple on the Temple Mount, and they speak openly of a missile hitting the Al-Aqsa mosque to clear the place for a third temple. So Edom, which is Amalek over there, set themselves up as the Jews.

“The king of the south” is Egypt. “Also the robbers of thy people”: that was the Herodians, Herod and Agrippa, who robbed our culture and our heritage and became Jews in the time of Christ. “Shall exalt themselves”, as the Jews, “to establish the vision” that they are the Jews.

So in 1948 they got the land again, set up schools throughout Israel and taught a new form of Hebrew, because the Hebrew that was spoken was extinct from 70 AD. The father of modern Hebrew made it up, fusing French, Arabic, Aramaic, Spanish and German words together, and Negroes argue about that stupid Hebrew today. Y’all dumb as a rock. They got the land, they made up a new language, and they call themselves Jewish. “But they shall fall.” That is the prophecy.

precepts.why: When the Greeks started to conquer us, what did they do? They “laid open the book of the law”, the Bible, “wherein the heathen had sought to paint the likeness of their images.” Even from the time of the Greeks, after Babylon and the Persians and Medes, they painted their images in our book and said that they were Moses, Joshua, Samson. That is them establishing the vision that they are the Jews.

“The earth is given into the hand of the wicked”: the wicked rule the earth. “He covereth the faces of the judges thereof”. The judges are God, Christ, the angels and the Israelites, the Jews, and they put their own images everywhere as the people of God. “If not, where, and who is he?”

It says the same thing. “The eye also of the adulterer”: that is the white man; he rapes and robs and pillages women. He “waiteth for the twilight, saying, No eye shall see me: and disguiseth his face.” He disguises his face as the Jews, as Jesus, as the angels, and nobody can believe that this man did all this.

“I have heard all thy blasphemies which thou hast spoken against the mountains of Israel, saying, They are laid desolate, they are given us to consume.” They said the real Jews are gone, the Israelites are finished, the land is ours now. “Thus with your mouth ye have boasted against me, and have multiplied your words against me: I have heard them.”

“When the whole earth rejoiceth, I will make thee desolate”: that is when they shall say peace and safety. “As thou didst rejoice at the inheritance of the house of Israel, because it was desolate”, because the twelve tribes were gone into captivity, “so will I do unto thee: thou shalt be desolate, O mount Seir, and all Idumea, even all of it”. Not some Idumea: all Idumea, the Greek and Roman name for Edom.

“Surely in the fire of my jealousy have I spoken against the residue of the heathen, and against all Idumea, which have appointed my land into their possession”. With Ezekiel 35:12 this identifies the race that would live in the land. No biblical text says Japheth lives in the land; the Bible says Idumea would take it and live in it.

“With the joy of all their heart”: they were happy to steal and spoil the land. “With despiteful minds”: despite knowing the land doesn’t belong to them and they are not the Jews. “To cast it out for a prey”: they called their fellow Idumeans from Poland, Russia, Germany, Ukraine, Kazakhstan and Uzbekistan to come and take a part. That is why they speak with German, Polish and Russian accents. They are not the people of the land.

This goes with them trying to establish the vision. “I know thy works, and tribulation, and poverty”: Christ knew the works of the Israelites in Smyrna, a colony of Israelites, and that they were impoverished, “(but thou art rich)”, because all the promises in the Bible pertain only to the Israelites.

“And I know the blasphemy of them which say they are Jews, and are not, but are the synagogue of Satan.” That is Herod, who said he was a Jew, and Agrippa and Bernice. They want to make this hate speech, but we are reading from the Bible.

“Behold, the devil shall cast some of you into prison”: Herod and Rome, who were hunting the Israelites down; Christ calls them the devil. “Be thou faithful unto death, and I will give thee a crown of life.” Christ is saying, I am not coming to save you; you have to take your death. When brothers get arrested today, like the political prisoners with no lawyers and no visitors, a black bag over the head, Guantanamo Bay, it is not that we forsook you; we can’t help you. Don’t be all in your feelings, saying nobody cares about me. Brother, shut the hell up and man up. That is going to be the case for some of us in here.

“Behold, I will make them of the synagogue of Satan, which say they are Jews, and are not, but do lie; behold, I will make them to come and worship before thy feet, and to know that I have loved thee.” That is a future prophecy that has not occurred yet.

Verse 1 gives the context: “For the ungodly said, reasoning with themselves, but not aright”. This ungodly is Esau. Then watch what Esau says of the Israelite: “He was made to reprove our thoughts.” The Israelite man, the prophet, was made to reprove their thoughts.

“He is grievous unto us even to behold”: just looking at us grieves them, because we are a constant reminder that we are the sons of God and they are not. “For his life is not like other men’s, his ways are of another fashion”, because we keep the commandments of God.

“We are esteemed of him as counterfeits”: that goes to Revelation 2:9 and 3:9. They are counterfeits, fakes, frauds; they are not the real Jews. Those are not our words; they are the words of God. And yet men like John Hagee and Christians United for Israel give their support to the counterfeit Israel, the synagogue of Satan.

sense.text:
Edom twists Daniel 9, and here is the code to break it down. Each day represents one year; each week represents seven years; seventy weeks equals 490 years. Write it down.

“Seventy weeks are determined upon thy people and upon thy holy city, to finish the transgression, and to make an end of sins”: that is Christ coming to die. “And to make reconciliation for iniquity”: all through Christ. “And to seal up the vision and prophecy, and to anoint the most Holy.” Christ is the one anointed as the most Holy.

“From the going forth of the commandment to restore and to build Jerusalem”: that began with Cyrus, when God told the Persians to let his people go to rebuild the temple. Israel was hindered for two years, then came Darius, then Artaxerxes, and they rebuilt under Zerubbabel, Joshua, Ezra, Nehemiah, Haggai and Zechariah.

“Unto the Messiah the Prince shall be seven weeks, and threescore and two weeks”: seven weeks plus 62 weeks is 69 weeks, 483 years. “The street shall be built again, and the wall, even in troublous times”: our forefathers caught hell from the nations trying to rebuild Jerusalem and the wall. They fought with a sword in one hand and a brick in the other.

“And after threescore and two weeks shall Messiah be cut off”: Christ shall be crucified, “but not for himself.” He did not die for himself; he died for the twelve tribes of Israel, for our people. “And the people of the prince that shall come”, Rome, “shall destroy the city and the sanctuary”: that is 70 AD.

After Rome destroyed Jerusalem, they built Aelia Capitolina on its ruins, named after the emperor Hadrian, and after the deities of the Capitoline Triad, Jupiter, Juno and Minerva: that is the trinity, where Christianity got that doctrine. A sanctuary to Jupiter, which is Zeus, the devil, was built on the Temple Mount, the place they are trying to build on again, and statues of their gods in the city. Jews were forbidden entrance to the city: they banned the real Jews. That name was given after the second revolt; Christ said leave, Israel said no, we are going to fight back and win, and we lost a second time. That is Daniel 9 right there.

“And he shall confirm the covenant with many for one week”: here is the last week, the seventieth. Amalek says that one week is not back then but now, when they rebuild the temple, counting on blacks and Latinos not understanding the scriptures, and because they are white the Christians say, okay.

“And in the midst of the week he shall cause the sacrifice and the oblation to cease”: Rome said to the Pharisees, no more sacrificing, and to hell with this crap. “And for the overspreading of abominations he shall make it desolate”: inside the temple, what Christ warned us about. The total of seventy weeks has been fulfilled. Don’t let Amalek take these dumb Christians and say that last week hasn’t occurred yet, that it is talking about now. Nope, wrong. Stop it.

precepts.why:
Why did we spend forty years in the wilderness? “After the number of the days in which ye searched the land, even forty days, each day for a year, shall ye bear your iniquities, even forty years”. Forty days they searched the land, and because they sinned, they were in the wilderness forty years. “And ye shall know my breach of promise”: God told them not to go up, and they went up anyway.

That is the formula: each day for a year, so the seventy weeks of Daniel 9 are 490 years.
“And thou shalt bear the iniquity of the house of Judah forty days: I have appointed thee each day for a year.” Each day for a year, the same formula, and with it we go back to Daniel 9.

“How God anointed Jesus of Nazareth with the Holy Ghost and with power: who went about doing good, and healing all that were oppressed of the devil; for God was with him.” Jesus is the anointed. So at the bottom of Daniel 9:24, “to anoint the most Holy”: Christ is the one anointed as the most Holy.

sense.text: The first temple was built by Solomon; the second was rebuilt by Zerubbabel and Joshua after the Persian captivity. The true third temple is here in Isaiah 60. “Surely the isles shall wait for me, and the ships of Tarshish first, to bring thy sons from far, their silver and their gold with them”.

“And the sons of strangers shall build up thy walls”: this is the building of the third temple by the other nations, because the other nations will be slaves. That makes some nervous, but that is what it says. They will be our servants and handmaids. “And their kings shall minister unto thee: for in my wrath I smote thee”: God was angry with us and smote us, and we went into slavery. “But in my favour have I had mercy on thee”: that is why he sent Christ.

“Therefore thy gates shall be open continually”: notice the kingdom is built from verses 10 and 11. “That men may bring unto thee the forces of the Gentiles”: forces means wealth. “And that their kings may be brought”: their kings brought in chains. “For the nation and kingdom that will not serve thee shall perish; yea, those nations shall be utterly wasted.”

“The glory of Lebanon shall come unto thee”: Lebanon belongs to the Israelites, and its glory is its trees; that is why the Lebanese flag has a tree, because they are known for the strongest and most beautiful trees. “To beautify the place of my sanctuary”: that is the third temple.

“The sons also of them that afflicted thee shall come bending unto thee”: we just read that in Revelation 3:9, saying the same thing. “And they shall call thee, The city of the Lord, The Zion of the Holy One of Israel.” That is the third temple, and the third temple is under Christ. They use Daniel 9 to talk about a third temple, believing we read and cannot reason.

precepts.why:
Here is the law, in case you were struggling with the sons of strangers building up the walls. “Moreover of the children of the strangers that do sojourn among you, of them shall ye buy”, “and they shall be your possession.” We shall own them, possess them as slaves.

“They shall be your bondmen for ever”: for how long? For ever. “But over your brethren the children of Israel, ye shall not rule one over another with rigour.”

What about the strangers? Will they be in the kingdom? Yes. “For the Lord will have mercy on Jacob”: not on everybody on the planet, on Jacob, the twelve tribes of Israel. “And will yet choose Israel, and set them in their own land”: not the League of Nations, not the UN; God will set them in their own land. “And the strangers shall be joined with them, and they shall cleave to the house of Jacob”, to obey us.

“And the people shall take them, and bring them to their place”: we are going to put all nations where they rightfully belong. The Arabs in North Africa don’t belong there; that belongs to Ham. The white man in Australia and in South Africa doesn’t belong there. “And the house of Israel shall possess them in the land of the Lord for servants and handmaids”: that is the law of Leviticus 25, and the laws will be re-implemented. “And they shall rule over their oppressors.”

“In the day that the Lord shall give thee rest from thy sorrow, and from thy fear, and from the hard bondage wherein thou wast made to serve”. That is why Christ said, come unto me all ye that labour and are heavy laden, and I will give you rest. Not just rest from sin: slavery and oppression are the result of sin. The Bible doesn’t contradict itself; Christianity contradicts the Bible.

Still speaking of the third temple. “And I saw thrones, and they sat upon them, and judgment was given unto them”: power was given unto them. “And I saw the souls of them that were beheaded for the witness of Jesus”, the martyrs, “and which had not worshipped the beast, neither his image, neither had received his mark upon their foreheads, or in their hands”. That lets you know somebody in these last days will not support it.

“And they lived and reigned with Christ a thousand years.” This is the third temple being built up: we are going to reign with Christ for a thousand years.

“And the nations of them which are saved shall walk in the light of it”: saved means left, and they are going to obey. “And the kings of the earth do bring their glory and honour into it. And the gates of it shall not be shut at all by day”: that is the third temple, the gates of Isaiah 60:11.

“And they shall bring the glory and honour of the nations into it.” The nations themselves are not walking in; they bring it up to the men of God at the gates. “And there shall in no wise enter into it any thing that defileth”, “but they which are written in the Lamb’s book of life.” That is the Israelites; only the Israelites are getting in.

Put it next to Revelation 21:24 to get the thought of who the saved nations are. “Every one that is left of all the nations which came against Jerusalem shall even go up from year to year to worship the King, the Lord of hosts, and to keep the feast of tabernacles.” Christ is not killing everybody; there will be remnants of the nations left over, and they come up to worship the King and keep the feast of tabernacles. They walk in the light by obeying the commandments.

sense.text:
If they want any scripture about a third temple, this is where you go; if they build that temple, this is what we are going to use. “Who opposeth and exalteth himself above all that is called God”: the white man, who opposes everything the Bible says.

“So that he as God sitteth in the temple of God, shewing himself that he is God.” Before 70 AD, Rome entered our temple and sat their rusty butt down. If they rebuild it, if the Lord allows them to be successful, he will sit in it to say, I am God, and everybody will cheer.

This is for the celebrities and all the brothers and sisters who are influential. When people hear they are Israel, some are so happy they run and tell everybody, even their Jewish friends. You become a target.

“Yea, truth faileth; and he that departeth from evil maketh himself a prey”: if you depart from evil, from the white man’s lies, Christianity, Judaism, all that foolishness, you become a prey to the red dragon, the Jewish community and the American government. That is what this walk is about.

So learn how to fight first, before you run out there talking. Reach out to the leaders and find out how you can be used in this war. Don’t be self-willed and run out there thinking you are battling somebody. Seek counsel. They tell their influential people to drop all talk of the Israelites or lose their contracts and endorsements; they fined Kyrie Irving for a tweet.

“And the Lord saw it, and it displeased him that there was no judgment.”

precepts.why:
To go along with that: our people who are celebrities, rich or famous, have to follow this truth the way Joseph of Arimathea did. “And after this Joseph of Arimathea, being a disciple of Jesus, but secretly”. He was a secret follower. He did not put himself out in front; he supported from behind the scenes.

Many of us love social media and tweet our whole life to everybody, and it is going to cost us in the end. Christ, when he entered into a city, would have no man know it.

sense.text:
A pastor went to Israel in 2018 and said God spoke to his heart there, and came back preaching that Jesus was not a black man. Shut the hell up: that was Amalek talking to him. “Though hand join in hand, the wicked shall not be unpunished”: join with these fake Israelis if you want. All these black pastors supporting them are holding hands with Amalek, and the wicked shall not be unpunished.

“But the seed of the righteous”, the twelve tribes of Israel, “shall be delivered.”

This is about the black pastors. “In those days went there out of Israel wicked men”: among our people are wicked men. “Who persuaded many, saying, Let us go and make a covenant with the heathen that are round about us”: with the Greeks, with the white man. “So this device pleased them well.”

We have always had certain men among us who are wicked, who made covenants and agreements with the white man. And the black pastors are not a threat to them. Y’all are dumb; y’all don’t know the Bible and you’re teaching heresies, so they’re not worried about you.

They made a covenant. “Because ye have said, We have made a covenant with death, and with hell are we at agreement; when the overflowing scourge shall pass through, it shall not come unto us”: that is these black pastors and politicians. “For we have made lies our refuge, and under falsehood have we hid ourselves”.

“Behold, I lay in Zion for a foundation a stone, a tried stone, a precious corner stone, a sure foundation”: this is Christ. “He that believeth shall not make haste”: make haste means you won’t be confounded. You won’t leave this truth.

“Judgment also will I lay to the line”: the Lord is going to bring forth judgment. “And the hail shall sweep away the refuge of lies”: the hail, the destruction, shall sweep away the refuge of Christianity, all the lies, and Islam as well.

“And your covenant with death shall be disannulled”: the covenant with the white man, the white man from Israel too. All the blacks that made a covenant with these fake Israelis, it shall be disannulled. “And your agreement with hell shall not stand”: hell is this low condition our people are in. “Then ye shall be trodden down by it”: those black pastors shall be trodden down.

“From the time that it goeth forth it shall take you”: from the time the teaching goes forth, it shall take you that made a covenant with death and hell. “For morning by morning shall it pass over, by day and by night”: you shall hear the proper teaching. “And it shall be a vexation only to understand the report.” Damn, I made a stupid damn covenant with these white folks, and these Israelites are bringing out the truth. But you already made that agreement, for the financial gain you wanted, and the report vexes you.

“For the bed is shorter than that a man can stretch himself on it”: you are in Christianity or politics, trying to find comfort after hearing the vexing report of the scriptures. You know it is true, but you already made that financial agreement. The bed is your lies, and there is not enough room. “And the covering narrower than that he can wrap himself in it”: you try to wrap yourself in your Christian lies, but you already heard the report, and it vexes you.

These black pastors, and the Latino pastors too, all went to the White House to pray for Trump, the president of peace, the man who blew up Venezuela and says he is coming for Cuba, Colombia, Mexico and Brazil. Reverend Lorenzo Sewell up there: this Negro is insane. You big dummy. He is going to put a foot in your behinds, all of you, and rightfully so. We don’t feel sorry for you.

precepts.why: “And are built upon the foundation of the apostles and prophets, Jesus Christ himself being the chief corner stone”. Christ is the chief corner stone, the tried stone laid in Zion. “In whom all the building fitly framed together groweth unto an holy temple in the Lord”: the holy temple is built upon Christ and the holy apostles.

sense.text:
The Latino and black pastors support Babylon and not God, not the Most High. “Whose possessors slay them”: the ones that possess us now are the white man, and he slays us: Rasheem Carter, Kendrick Johnson, Breonna Taylor, Philando Castile, Sandra Bland, George Floyd. They were hunting us on Epstein Island. “And hold themselves not guilty.”

“And they that sell them say, Blessed be the Lord; for I am rich”: they got rich from selling us. The majority of the wealth America has came from 400 years of free chattel slavery.

“And their own shepherds pity them not.” Our own shepherds are our pastors and our congressmen and women. They pity us not, because they are getting a piece of the American pie. They don’t give a damn about our brothers and sisters being shot down in the street. They don’t give a damn about Rasheem Carter or Kendrick Johnson.

This comes after chapter 17, where John sees Babylon. “Babylon the great is fallen, is fallen”: it goes back to chapter 17. Why does it say it twice? Because Israel is little Babylon. “And is become the habitation of devils, and the hold of every foul spirit”.

“For all nations have drunk of the wine of the wrath of her fornication”: that is their policies, what we read in Daniel 8, that through his policy he shall cause craft to prosper in his hand. All nations follow their policies. “And the kings of the earth”, the nations, “have committed fornication with her”: they got in bed with her. “And the merchants of the earth”, the corporations and companies, “are waxed rich through the abundance of her delicacies.”

“Come out of her, my people, that ye be not partakers of her sins, and that ye receive not of her plagues.” This lets you know where the Israelites are: in Babylon. They say Babylon is Iraq. No: it is letting you know the twelve tribes are here.

There are pastors who have made a covenant with death and hell, who say, because we’re Christians we love the Jews, they are the chosen people of God, and who go to Israel with all expenses paid, delegations of Christian leaders from Africa too. A gift destroys the heart.

precepts.why:
Read the end of chapter 17 to get the thought before chapter 18. “The waters which thou sawest, where the whore sitteth, are peoples, and multitudes, and nations, and tongues.” The whore is the Statue of Liberty, Lady Liberty. She sits upon many waters; she is everywhere.

“And the ten horns which thou sawest upon the beast, these shall hate the whore”: the ten horns are Belgium, Luxembourg, the Netherlands, Germany, the United Kingdom, Italy, Greece, France, Denmark and Ireland. They shall hate America; it is going to be an ambush, they are going to trick Babylon. “And shall make her desolate and naked, and shall eat her flesh, and burn her with fire”: the entire country is going to be destroyed.

“For God hath put in their hearts to fulfil his will”, “until the words of God shall be fulfilled.” When the prophets go out teaching, there is a time limit for us to be out there.

“And the woman which thou sawest is that great city, which reigneth over the kings of the earth.” We call it a country; God calls it a city. Nobody rules and dominates America; America reigns over everybody. That is Babylon, which is fallen in Revelation 18.

sense.text: This is regarding our people that have made a covenant with death and hell. When people on the street bring up Romans 11, start with verse 26, because verse 26 explains the whole chapter. “And so all Israel shall be saved”: that is the elect, the southern kingdom and the northern kingdom. “There shall come out of Sion the Deliverer”: that is Christ. “And shall turn away ungodliness from Jacob”: he died on the cross for us and only us.
“For this is my covenant unto them, when I shall take away their sins.” Whose sins? Israel’s, from the verse above.

“As concerning the gospel, they are enemies for your sakes”: those are our people that made a covenant with Rome, with Babylon, whether religious or political. “But as touching the election, they are beloved for the fathers’ sakes”, because these same people that are against us can repent.
“For the gifts and calling of God are without repentance.” We didn’t have to repent, because he already died on the cross for us. We weren’t even there, and he died.
“Write thee all the words that I have spoken unto thee in a book”: the Bible.

“I will bring again the captivity of my people Israel and Judah”. You might think this means the Lord is going to make us slaves again. No: it means he is going to bring us again to our land, and he explains it right there: “and I will cause them to return to the land that I gave to their fathers, and they shall possess it.”

“We have heard a voice of trembling, of fear, and not of peace”: there is going to come a time of trembling and fear, and there will be no peace. “Ask ye now, and see whether a man doth travail with child?” Does a man give birth? “Wherefore do I see every man with his hands on his loins, as a woman in travail”: Jeremiah sees men holding their stomachs like they are giving birth. “And all faces are turned into paleness”: everybody is afraid.

“Alas! for that day is great, so that none is like it: it is even the time of Jacob’s trouble”: the great tribulation. “But he shall be saved out of it.”

People ask what the difference is between the tribulations we have gone through and this last one. “None is like it.” This tribulation will not be like any other because there will be war like we have never seen, with pestilence and plague; World War is going to be in the midst, and Christ comes in the midst of it. That is called Armageddon.

precepts.why: “For, behold, in those days, and in that time, when I shall bring again the captivity of Judah and Jerusalem”: the same words. Bringing again the captivity does not mean making us slaves again; Jeremiah 30:3 explains it: God causes us to return to the land he gave our fathers.

The one verse, “he shall be saved out of it”, doesn’t go into much detail, so pay attention. “And ye shall be hated of all men for my name’s sake”: Christ prophesied we would be hated of all men for his sake. Brothers and sisters ask why the white man hates us so much: because we are the sons and daughters of God, the people of Christ. “But he that endureth to the end shall be saved.” We have to endure the hatred.

“But when they persecute you in this city, flee ye into another”: when you brothers go to other countries, check out the real estate, whether you can get citizenship or residency, because if something pops off here we have to be able to move. One city may pop off and the next may not have the same persecution.

“Ye shall not have gone over the cities of Israel, till the Son of man be come”: we will not reach all twelve tribes, every Israelite, before Christ comes.

This is how we know we are not reaching all the Israelites everywhere. “And I will set a sign among them, and I will send those that escape of them unto the nations”: those that escape are the 144,000. “To Tarshish”, Spain, “Pul, and Lud”, Libya and Lydia, “that draw the bow”, Turkey, “and Javan”, Greece, “to the isles afar off”, like the thousands of Melanesian islands, “that have not heard my fame, neither have seen my glory”: that have not heard the gospel. So the 144,000 are going to collect the Israelites in these other nations.

“And they shall bring all your brethren for an offering unto the Lord out of all nations upon horses, and in chariots”, “to my holy mountain Jerusalem”. The kingdom is already set up at this time, and the third temple is built. “And I will also take of them for priests and for Levites”: the brothers and sisters gathered from among those nations, the Lord makes them priests and Levites.

A precept for “none is like it.” “And there shall be a time of trouble, such as never was since there was a nation even to that same time: and at that time thy people shall be delivered, every one that shall be found written in the book.” The time of Jacob’s trouble is a trouble such as never was.

What is the difference between the coming tribulation and the last ones? Christ said it, and we read it earlier. “Immediately after the tribulation of those days shall the sun be darkened”, “and the stars shall fall from heaven, and the powers of the heavens shall be shaken”: Christ is going to be fighting all the nations. “And then shall appear the sign of the Son of man in heaven: and then shall all the tribes of the earth mourn”.

The difference is that there is going to be war during the time of our great tribulation, pestilence and plague, wars like we have never seen before.

sense.text: “Then shall they deliver you up to be afflicted, and shall kill you”: this is tribulation. “And ye shall be hated of all nations for my name’s sake.”

“And then shall many be offended”: many of you Israelites shall be offended, “and shall betray one another”. Some of you men and women will betray this truth. God hates a betrayer; every time you read of a betrayer, the Lord had them killed with a horrible death. You are not betraying us; you are betraying the King of kings.

“And many false prophets shall rise”: that is Christianity; many of them will rise. “And because iniquity shall abound”, sin shall abound, “the love of many shall wax cold. But he that shall endure unto the end”: the end is either your death or Christ’s return. “The same shall be saved.”

“And this gospel of the kingdom shall be preached in all the world for a witness unto all nations”. That does not contradict Isaiah 66. The world spoken of here is the 144,000. The 144,000 are scattered among the nations, and that is why we must go out and prophesy and teach among all these different nations, because our people are there. “And then shall the end come.”

“When ye therefore shall see the abomination of desolation, spoken of by Daniel the prophet, stand in the holy place”. Christ called the white man the abomination of desolation. It was true back then, but guess who is in the land today? The same people. “Whoso readeth, let him understand.”

precepts.why:
Here is the precept. The Bible did not contradict itself. Keep the thought in mind: when this gospel is preached in all the world for a witness unto all nations, then shall the end come.

“I saw four angels standing on the four corners of the earth, holding the four winds of the earth”: the four winds are destruction. “That the wind should not blow on the earth, nor on the sea, nor on any tree”: the earth is the armies on land, the sea is the navy and the marines, and the trees are the air force that comes down above the trees.

“And I saw another angel ascending from the east, having the seal of the living God”. Then verse 3 is the point that ties in with Matthew 24: “Hurt not the earth, neither the sea, nor the trees, till we have sealed the servants of our God in their foreheads.” Don’t let the destruction come until the servants of God are sealed. “And there were sealed an hundred and forty and four thousand of all the tribes of the children of Israel.” Once the 144,000 are sealed, then shall the end come: destruction upon destruction upon destruction.

Write this precept down: what is the wind in Revelation 7? “There was gathered together a multitude of men, out of number, from the four winds of the heaven, to subdue the man that came out of the sea”. A multitude of men out of the four winds, coming to fight Christ, the Son of God. That goes back to Daniel 8:25: he shall stand up against the Prince of princes, but he shall be broken without hand.

What is “the seal of the living God” the angel carries in Revelation 7:2? “Bind up the testimony, seal the law among my disciples.” That is what the angel is looking for, the law sealed among the disciples, and that is what he is doing before the end comes.

sense.text: “For, behold, the burning wrath of a great multitude is kindled over you”: the enemies of God. “And they shall take away certain of you, and feed you, being idle, with things offered unto idols”: that is Christianity, Roman Catholicism. If you are idle and don’t study, they are going to feed you with it. When persecution comes and you are fearful and cannot endure to the end, you just give up and betray the King of kings.

“And they that consent unto them”, to Christianity, “shall be had in derision and in reproach, and trodden under foot.” Even the white man hates a traitor. You think you will join the white man and escape. No, you are not. In Planet of the Apes the traitor apes had the word donkey on their backs, because you’re a jackass. That is going to be some of you men and women, because you want to be a jackass to the white man. And when they didn’t need them any more, they killed them. And when you face the King, where are you going to be? The lake of fire. You just stupid, after all we’ve been teaching y’all.

“For there shall be in every place, and in the next cities, a great insurrection upon those that fear the Lord.” That is what Christ said: you shall be hated of all men. “They shall be like mad men, sparing none, but still spoiling”, robbing, “and destroying those that fear the Lord.” That is why Christ said, when they persecute you in this city, flee into the next. Esdras says the same thing in more detail.

“For they shall waste and take away their goods, and cast them out of their houses”: they will take our homes. This is the prophecy. “Then shall they be known, who are my chosen”: those that endure, you will know they are the chosen. “And they shall be tried as the gold in the fire.”

precepts.why:
How do we know the things offered unto idols are Christianity? “Now the Spirit speaketh expressly, that in the latter times some shall depart from the faith”. Some of you are going to depart from this faith, because persecution is coming: when you can’t pay your bills or get food, you will leave.

Think about digital currency. America wants to bring it in so it can control us. In China, if you jaywalk, they take it out of your bank account. Imagine they say you are not allowed to teach the gospel or gather on the seventh day, and when we do it anyway, your digital bank account is hit. That is how they will make people do what they want.

“Giving heed to seducing spirits, and doctrines of devils; speaking lies in hypocrisy; having their conscience seared with a hot iron”. What is the doctrine of devils? He explains it: “Forbidding to marry”: what religion forbids men to marry? Catholicism, Christianity. “And commanding to abstain from meats”: that is Lent, no meat for forty days. Those are the things offered unto idols that 2 Esdras 16:68 says they will feed you.

sense.text: “And the Lord shall scatter you among the nations”: slavery. “And ye shall be left few in number among the heathen”, because they were killing us.
“And there ye shall serve gods, the work of men’s hands”: idolatry. “Wood and stone”: Islam and Christianity, “which neither see, nor hear, nor eat, nor smell.”

“But if from thence”, from those lands you were taken to, “thou shalt seek the Lord thy God, thou shalt find him”: we are seeking him now, here in America, and we are finding him. “If thou seek him with all thy heart and with all thy soul”: Christ said, if you love me, keep my commandments.

“When thou art in tribulation”: Moses prophesied we would be in tribulation, the same tribulation Christ warned us about and Esdras just told us about. “Even in the latter days”: these are the latter days. “If thou turn to the Lord thy God, and shalt be obedient unto his voice”.

“He will not forsake thee, neither destroy thee”: destroy means the lake of fire. That is why in Revelation 2 Christ said to the Israelites in Smyrna, be faithful unto death and I will give you a crown of life. “Nor forget the covenant of thy fathers which he sware unto them.”

Christians go to Revelation 7:9 to try to confuse you. “A great multitude, which no man could number, of all nations, and kindreds, and people, and tongues, stood before the throne”. Who are these people of all nations, kindreds and tongues? They are the Israelites scattered among all nations. If you are on the street and let them confound you with Revelation 7:9, shame on you.

precepts.why: “And there were dwelling at Jerusalem Jews, devout men, out of every nation under heaven.” Jews out of every nation: the multitude of all nations is Israel scattered among the nations.

“Confess him before the Gentiles, ye children of Israel: for he hath scattered us among them.” He scattered us among them. “There declare his greatness”: the same thing Moses said in Deuteronomy 4. “And extol him before all the living: for he is our Lord, and he is the God our Father for ever.”

When they say on the street that the people coming out of all nations are all peoples: no. “When I shall have gathered the house of Israel from the people among whom they are scattered, and shall be sanctified in them in the sight of the heathen, then shall they dwell in their land that I have given to my servant Jacob.” It is the house of Israel gathered out of the peoples.
“To the twelve tribes which are scattered abroad, greeting.” The twelve tribes are scattered abroad among the nations; they are the multitude of all nations, kindreds, people and tongues.

sense.text: This is when Christ said, then shall appear the sign of the Son of man; Habakkuk 3 breaks it down for us. “O Lord, I have heard thy speech, and was afraid”. “O Lord, revive thy work in the midst of the years”: the midst of the years is time, times and half a time; he is reviving us now. “In the midst of the years make known”: make your word known. “In wrath remember mercy.”
This is a day you have never seen. “God came from Teman, and the Holy One from mount Paran. Selah.” Selah means it is true. “His glory covered the heavens”: that is what Matthew 24 was saying.

“He had horns coming out of his hand”: Christ is going to have power coming out of his hands; horns mean power. Forget the X-Men and the Avengers; they got that from the Bible. “And there was the hiding of his power”: he had to hold back, because Christ created everything, and if he let loose his full power he would destroy the whole planet.

“Before him went the pestilence”: when Christ touches down, before him goes the pestilence. “And burning coals went forth at his feet”: imagine when his feet touch down, fire erupts everywhere and the earth breaks up.

“He stood, and measured the earth: he beheld, and drove asunder the nations”: he destroyed the nations. “And the everlasting mountains were scattered”: the great nations, the powers. “The perpetual hills did bow”: the smaller countries.
“I saw the tents of Cushan in affliction”: that is Ethiopia; Habakkuk sees Ethiopia in affliction. “And the curtains of the land of Midian did tremble”: the Midianites, the Arabs.
“Was the Lord displeased against the rivers?” The rivers are nations, as we read in Isaiah 17. “That thou didst ride upon thine horses and thy chariots of salvation?”

“Thy bow was made quite naked, according to the oaths of the tribes, even thy word.” When you have a bow in your hand, you are coming for war. The oaths of the tribes is the Bible, his word. According to the oaths of Jacob, Christ is coming for war. “Selah”: it is true. “Thou didst cleave the earth with rivers”: with nations.

“The deep uttered his voice, and lifted up his hands on high”: the ocean like a tsunami lifting up its hands. “The sun and moon stood still in their habitation”: time stood still. “At the light of thine arrows they went, and at the shining of thy glittering spear”: all the missiles being shot.

“Thou didst march through the land in indignation”: indignation means righteous anger. “Thou didst thresh the heathen in anger”: he beats the nations in anger. “Thou wentest forth for the salvation of thy people”: he is only coming to save the twelve tribes of Israel; we don’t see why people are so confused about that. “Thou woundedst the head out of the house of the wicked”: that is the white man; America is the head. “By discovering the foundation unto the neck”: to make sure America is finished.

“They came out as a whirlwind to scatter me”: they came out to scatter Christ. “Their rejoicing was as to devour the poor secretly”: they get happy to destroy us, but secretly. They are not saying, I want to kill you niggers. They put it in the food, Popeyes, KFC, McDonald’s, and in our music to destroy our minds. They engineer the food to spike your insulin and keep it high, so you get diabetes, gout, arthritis, pains and fibroids: it is a science to destroy you. Before KFC and Popeyes came to Jamaica and Africa, the women were slim.

They have a new technology that can target your DNA and attack a certain people, the way Pharaoh said, let us deal wisely with them, and destroyed the babies. Esau knows what to look for when he is looking for the sons of God; he can tell David’s lineage from DNA. Don’t be getting them damn DNA tests. Everything they do is in secret. The Bible says it: they are out to destroy us.
“Thou didst walk through the sea with thine horses, through the heap of great waters”: you walked through the nations with your chariots, through the heap of great nations.

“When I heard, my belly trembled; my lips quivered at the voice: rottenness entered into my bones”: fear on top of fear. “That I might rest in the day of trouble”: Habakkuk is saying, I want to be at rest when Christ returns; I don’t want to live through this. The prophets were in the vision. They could feel the heat, see the death, smell the flesh. It is different looking at a screen than being in the midst of destruction.

“When he cometh up unto the people”, when Christ comes up unto the nations, “he will invade them with his troops.” That is why Trump created Space Force: they know there will be an invasion. The files about what they call aliens are really about the angels on the Lord’s chariots.

precepts.why: Hold the bow made quite naked. “When I have bent Judah for me”: God bends Judah for himself like a bow. “Filled the bow with Ephraim, and raised up thy sons, O Zion”: the rest of the twelve tribes. “Against thy sons, O Greece”: against the Greeks, the white man. That is war: according to the oaths of the tribes, Christ comes with his bow for war.

sense.text: “Therefore shall her plagues come in one day”: the destruction of America shall come in one day. “For strong is the Lord God who judgeth her”: God is judging America.

“And the kings of the earth, who have committed fornication and lived deliciously with her”: they got rich and wealthy. “For in one hour is thy judgment come.” It is going to take one hour to destroy this place.

“And the merchants of the earth shall weep and mourn over her; for no man buyeth their merchandise any more”: the corporations of the earth. America is the one that makes nations wealthy, by buying and selling with them. “And slaves, and souls of men”: just in case you didn’t think it was America. That is America.

“And the fruits that thy soul lusted after are departed from thee, and all things which were dainty and goodly are departed from thee, and thou shalt find them no more at all.” Everything you love in America is going to depart: the Twinkies, the cupcakes, no more Popeyes, no more Kentucky Fried Chicken, no more McDonald’s, no more Burger King, because you don’t understand what is in that food.
“For in one hour so great riches is come to nought.”

“What city is like unto this great city!” Who is like America? There is no country like the United States of America. “For in one hour is she made desolate.” One hour is all it will take the Lord to make sure these nations destroy America.
